title: Human Rating v1
description: Companion schema for spec/judge-record-family-v1.md section 5. The root schema validates a Human Rating record: a human's rating of one cited case, blind by construction. blind is fixed true -- a non-blind human rating is not a legal record in this schema; a producer that needs to record a non-blind rating uses a different record shape, it does not set this field to false. rater_ref is an opaque principal reference (Evidence Layer's principal_ref convention) -- never a name; a rater's identity binding is host-defined and out of scope here, exactly as the owning document states for principal_ref generally. epistemic_type is fixed to human_report -- asserted by a human, not machine-observed.

PrincipalRef.description: Opaque identifier; the scheme that gives it meaning is host-defined (Evidence Layer, principal_ref). Never a display name, email, or other directly identifying string -- a rater is a reference a host can resolve, not a label this record carries in the clear.
